name: Corcos del Valle (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of red, white and red with a double-width white stripe charged with two blue wavy stripes.
history: The heraldic arms and the flag were officially approved on 27 June 2007 and published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León of 28 April 2008; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of three vertical stripes in proportions 1/4, 1/2 and 1/4, the outer ones red and the central one white with two blue wavy stripes.

features.role: two wavy stripes across the central white stripe
